items.t: In Aldergrove, houses sold at a median of $1,025,000 across 86 sales, and the middle half closed between $895,000 and $1,210,750. The median house sat 14 days and sold for 97.0% of list.
Aldergrove: 15 townhomes sold at a median of $560,000, with the middle half between $526,000 and $572,500. The median townhome took 18 days to sell and closed at 97.5% of list.
31 condos sold in Aldergrove at a median of $432,500 (middle half $372,500 to $520,000). A typical condo in Aldergrove spent 22 days on the market and closed at 97.8% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Aldergrove compares with the rest of Langley

items.t: Houses in Aldergrove have the lowest median of the 9 Langley sub-areas, $1,025,000, below Langley City at $1,200,000; the highest is Campbell Valley at $2,565,000.
Townhomes in Aldergrove have the lowest median of the 6 Langley sub-areas, $560,000, below Langley City at $740,000; the highest is Fort Langley at $1,395,000.
Condos in Aldergrove have the lowest median of the 7 Langley sub-areas, $432,500, below Langley City at $463,000; the highest is Fort Langley at $800,000.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Aldergrove (median 2025) and houses the oldest (median 1981), a gap of 44 years.
